functions.coverage: Press captures the current identifier; release compares and clears the capture. A tracker used by the shadow and opt-in engine-button confirmation mode implements button snapshot sequencing, counter advancement before early returns, suppression and unchanged-input gates, target adoption, idle bookkeeping, float-rounded cursor/wheel accumulation, delta-correcting XY clipping, normalized cursor-frame projection and position/world-update order, click inhibition, signed less-than-400 double-click detection, previous-target updates and release reset.
functions.limitations: Portable identifiers replace original object ABI. The opt-in bridge polls original device buttons; positions/focus remain host supplied and timing is clamped host QPC. The probe uses Win32 timestamps as a tentative clock, resets across confirmation sessions, and does not dispatch double-clicks; the original delta is bounded, potentially scaled milliseconds, but the complete original frame loop remains absent. Cursor-frame position/world updates have bounded desktop confirmation. The opt-in main-menu adapter now shares that update path but awaits its own desktop check. Cursor storage is portable and seeded from host coordinates; effective motion is reconstructed but its samples remain approximate. Original x87 control-word behavior is not reproduced. The interactive host additionally cancels on pointer departure or focus loss.
